title: Assessing Socio-Cultural Alignment and Technical Safety of Sovereign LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation using multiple-choice questions regarding regional society, history, and traditions across six countries, combined with human evaluation of open-ended question-answering and story generation tasks to assess socio-cultural alignment.
Comparing model performance, accuracy, and generated text fluency across a mix of high-resource languages (English, French, Chinese) and low-resource languages (Korean, Thai, Norwegian).
Evaluating model robustness against adversarial jailbreak prompts designed to elicit targeted hate speech or discrimination against specific ethnic groups and religions.
